sub: Resource servers register the resources they hold for you here. For each one, choose who may reach it and with which scopes. Nothing is shared until you share it: with no share, nobody but you is let in.
off: User-Managed Access is turned off in this realm, so nobody can ask for your resources now. Your shares are kept.
noResources: No resource server has registered a resource for you yet.
recipientRealm: anyone signed in to this realm
kind: {kind, select, person {A person} group {A group} realm {Anyone signed in here} claim {Anyone with a claim} other {{kind}}}
recipientField: Username, group name, or the claim's value:
pendingNone: No request is waiting for your approval.
customSub: These rules of your sharing policy were not written by the form above, so they are shown as written.
alfaSub: Your sharing policy, written in ALFA. Saving it replaces the policy and ends every token issued over your resources.
doneRemoved: Share removed; {revoked} token(s) that carried it were revoked.
doneAlfa: Policy saved; {revoked} token(s) over your resources were revoked.
withMeSub: The resources other people share with you, and which applications hold a token to reach them.
withMeNone: Nobody shares anything with you at the moment.
doneApproved: Approved: a share for that person was added for a day.
